title: British and Irish Bundesliga players
brief: Name any player from England, Scotland, Wales, Northern Ireland or the Republic of Ireland who played at least one Bundesliga game between 2000/01 and 2025/26.

notes.Jamal Musiala: Musiala counts as German (English citizenship is only his second nationality), so he does not count.
notes.Michael Olise: Olise is listed under France, not England, so he does not count.
notes.Lewis Holtby: Holtby counts as German (English citizenship is only his second nationality), so he does not count.
notes.Aaron Hunt: Hunt counts as German (English citizenship is only his second nationality), so he does not count.
notes.Ademola Lookman: Lookman is listed under Nigeria, not England, so he does not count.
notes.Michael Mancienne: Mancienne is listed under Seychelles, not England, so he does not count.
notes.Felix Nmecha: Nmecha counts as German (English citizenship is only his second nationality), so he does not count.
notes.Lukas Nmecha: Nmecha counts as German (English citizenship is only his second nationality), so he does not count.
notes.Nathan Tella: Tella is listed under Nigeria, not England, so he does not count.
notes.Demarai Gray: Gray is listed under Jamaica, not England, so he does not count.
notes.Carney Chukwuemeka: Chukwuemeka is listed under Austria, not England, so he does not count.
notes.Kevin Keegan: Keegan played for Hamburg from 1977 to 1980, before this board starts.
notes.Tony Woodcock: Woodcock played for Koln in the 1980s, before this board starts.
notes.Paul Lambert: Lambert played for Dortmund from 1996 to 1997, before this board starts.
notes.Mark Hughes: Hughes played for Bayern in 1987/88, before this board starts.
notes.Ethan Nwaneri: Nwaneri joined Dortmund for 2026/27, after this board ends.
notes.Mikey Moore: Moore joined Koln for 2026/27, after this board ends.
notes.Reigan Heskey: Heskey joined Koln for 2026/27, after this board ends.

checks: Every name in the England, Scotland, Wales and Republic of Ireland sections of Wikipedia's list of foreign Bundesliga players whose spell overlaps 2000/01 to 2025/26 (36 players; there is no Northern Ireland section) was checked against Transfermarkt's club season stats pages for every club and season from 2000/01 to 2025/26: all 36 have at least one league appearance. In the other direction, every player Transfermarkt lists with a British or Irish first nationality is on the Wikipedia list. Keanan Bennetts and Conor Noss are on Wikipedia's England and Republic of Ireland lists while Transfermarkt gives Germany first and England or Ireland second; they are kept because both sources give them that nationality. Players whose British or Irish citizenship is only second on Transfermarkt and who are listed under another country on Wikipedia (Musiala, Olise, Lookman and others) are left out.
